definitions.explanation: To move something back and forth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尻尾|しっぽ}→しっぽ：09089_shippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}って⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいる→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The dog is wagging its tail happily.
When the train departed, the children on the platform waved their hands widely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧レモン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}って→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}った。

examples.english: Sprinkling a little pepper as a finishing touch greatly improves the flavor.

notes:
{振|ふ}る is a godan verb meaning to wave, shake, or sprinkle.

CONJUGATION:
{振|ふ}らない (neg), {振|ふ}ります (polite), {振|ふ}って (te-form), {振|ふ}った (past)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手|て}を{振|ふ}る: to wave (one's hand)
- {首|くび}を{振|ふ}る: to shake one's head (disagreement)
- {尻尾|しっぽ}を{振|ふ}る: to wag one's tail
- {塩|しお}を{振|ふ}る: to sprinkle salt
- サイコロを{振|ふ}る: to roll dice
- {振|ふ}り{向|む}く: to turn around

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {振|ふ}る: to wave, shake (transitive)
- {降|ふ}る: to fall (rain/snow) (intransitive)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {振動|しんどう}: vibration
- {振替|ふりかえ}: transfer, exchange
